meta.name: headline-matrix
meta.description: Generate high-performing headline variations across different angles. Trigger on "headlines", "hooks", "ad copy", "email subject lines".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成多角度高转化标题变体
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为营销内容批量测试不同标题角度
copy.tagline_en: Generate high-performing headline variations across multiple angles
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to test different headline angles for marketing content

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会根据你提供的主题，生成 25 条不同角度的标题变体，涵盖好奇心、具体性、证明、紧迫性、反常识、机制、身份等类型。
howto.when: 当你提到“标题”、“钩子”、“广告文案”、“邮件主题行”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我写 25 条关于减肥产品的广告标题。
say.note: Claude 会生成不同角度的标题。

say.text: 为我的博客文章生成一些好奇心钩子。
say.note: Claude 会输出好奇心类标题。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates 25 headline variations from different angles (curiosity, specificity, proof, urgency, contrarian, mechanism, identity) based on your topic.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "headlines", "hooks", "ad copy", "email subject lines".

say_en.text: Write 25 ad headlines for a weight loss product.
Generate curiosity hooks for my blog post.
